verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own materials list a native Automations product and webhook-style event triggers ('Trigger workflows from ClickUp events'). They also advertise a Super Agent that 'works 24/7' with delegated tasks, plus specialized agents such as a Triage Agent that prioritizes bugs, which points to autonomous background execution. However, every source is a one-line marketing or nav-level claim with no depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how automations and agents are configured, triggered and scheduled; evidence of guardrails or monitoring for unattended runs; and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents actually run autonomously.
